title: Fake Dials Web Wallpaper
description: A Wallpaper Engine project that features a collection of fake dials, designed to be visually appealing and interactive. The wallpaper also showcases a clock.
Highlights: Interactive and animated gauge dials visualizing simulated CPU, RAM, and Fan telemetry via PureKnob canvas rendering
Real-time digital HUD clock displaying 12-hour formatted time and calendar date with dynamic updates
Responsive design with automatic viewport scaling for seamless multi-resolution display in Wallpaper Engine
Published and distributed on the Steam Workshop for desktop customization
